source_results.motivation: v070 removed the grid-sensitive first-crossing pathology but failed only its four-lambda affinity gate. After the result, the preregistered finite difference of ln Dbar was recognized to contain intrinsic O(lambda^2) estimator terms even for an affine perturbation-state response. v071 therefore tests the eta=0 odd tangent of Dbar itself before dividing by the baseline Dbar.

scope: Linear-theory broadband onset diagnostic only. No nonlinear evolution, nonlinear saturation, halo dynamics, screening, N-body dynamics, or observational likelihood is used.
historical_results_policy: v067 through v070 classifications and artifacts remain unchanged. v071 is a new result-informed estimator follow-up and is not a relabeling or rerun of v070.

direct_spectrum_grid.evaluation: Direct classy.pk_lin at every requested (k,z); no CLASS native-grid P(k) interpolation.

dimensionless_power.broadband_definition: Same arithmetic centered ln-k top-hat average as v070.
dimensionless_power.baseline_crossing_rule: Same first upward crossing of the baseline broadband Dbar as v070; interpolate ln Dbar linearly versus ln k.

exact_eta0_tangent_estimator.state_affinity_hypothesis: For an affine eta=0 externally forced perturbation state, any linear transfer amplitude is affine in lambda and the corresponding power/broadband power is at most quadratic: Dbar(lambda)=A+lambda B+lambda^2 C.
exact_eta0_tangent_estimator.partial_eta_Dbar: [Dbar(+lambda)-Dbar(-lambda)]/(2 lambda), evaluated at the fixed baseline broadband crossing.
exact_eta0_tangent_estimator.partial_eta_ln_Dbar: partial_eta_Dbar / Dbar(0); at the baseline threshold crossing Dbar(0)=the preregistered threshold.
exact_eta0_tangent_estimator.implicit_shift: d ln k_thr/d eta = - [partial_eta ln Dbar] / [partial_ln_k ln Dbar] at the fixed baseline broadband crossing.
exact_eta0_tangent_estimator.why_not_log_finite_difference: The v070 estimator [ln Dbar(+lambda)-ln Dbar(-lambda)]/(2 lambda) has intrinsic O(lambda^2) dependence for quadratic Dbar(lambda) and is therefore not an exact lambda-affinity test of the odd tangent.

science_classification_after_numerical_p.delay: V071_EXACT_BROADBAND_MEMORY_DELAY_SUPPORTED if, for both preregistered widths, at least 5/7 Delta_L^2=1 implicit mean shifts are positive and the two widths agree in sign at least 6/7 redshifts.
science_classification_after_numerical_p.advance: V071_EXACT_BROADBAND_MEMORY_ADVANCE_SUPPORTED if, for both preregistered widths, at least 5/7 Delta_L^2=1 implicit mean shifts are negative and the two widths agree in sign at least 6/7 redshifts.
science_classification_after_numerical_p.mixed: V071_EXACT_BROADBAND_ONSET_SHIFT_MIXED otherwise, provided all numerical gates pass.
science_classification_after_numerical_p.numerical_fail: V071_EXACT_BROADBAND_ONSET_TANGENT_FAIL if any primary numerical gate fails.

secondary_descriptive_tests.compare_v070_estimator: Report only as context that v071 changes the tangent estimator, not the physical model, grid, thresholds, broadband widths, or science-sign rule.
secondary_descriptive_tests.transition_overlap: Report the fraction of baseline broadband threshold crossings in the historical k=0.08--0.20 h/Mpc band.
secondary_descriptive_tests.width_dependence: Report both widths without post-hoc preference.

anti_tuning: All v071 physical parameters, lambda values, direct grid, thresholds, broadband widths, exact odd-tangent estimator, numerical gates, and science classification are committed before the v071 result.
